name: Canned Food
description: Snack; Non-perishable, in a can.
effect: As an action once per hour, receive 1 healing

name: Slice of Bread
description: Snack; Freshly baked.
effect: As an action once per hour, Restore 1 Mana

name: Fancy Cigars
description: Tightly-rolled tobacco.
effect: As an action once per hour, Removed charmed, confused or fear condition.

name: Dried Fruit Mix
description: Snack; A nutritious blend of various dried fruits.
effect: As an action once per hour, advantage to next Mental check

name: Traveler's Tea Kit
description: Meal; Compact set for brewing tea on the go.
effect: As a 1 hour action up to 3 times per day, Restore 3 Mana

name: Spiced Nuts
description: Snack; A bag of mixed nuts seasoned with exotic spices.
effect: As an action once per hour, advantage to next Physical check

name: Preserved Meats
description: Snack; Salted and dried meats, good for long journeys.
effect: As an action once per hour, receive 1 healing

name: Nice Coffee
description: A hot, bracing brew.
effect: As an action once per hour, Remove the Exhausted condition.

name: Harmonica
description: Mouth-played instrument.

name: Banjo
description: 4/5-stringed, circular frame.

name: Tin Whistle
description: Six-holed woodwind.

name: Sheet Music
description: Printed popular songs.

name: Gramophone Record
description: For gramophones.

name: Travel Guitar
description: Compact, lightweight guitar ideal for traveling.

name: Pan Flute
description: Set of pipes producing melodious sounds.

name: Djembe Drum
description: Hand drum with rich, versatile beats.

name: Accordion
description: Hand-held bellows-driven instrument.

name: Violin
description: Classic stringed instrument with emotional range.

name: Handcuffs
description: Iron restraints with a small key.
effect: As an action, apply to a willing creature to give it the Constrained condition.

name: Pocket Knife
description: Foldable multi-blade.

name: Shoe Shine Kit
description: Brush, cloth, and polish.
effect: Gives a temporary +1 bonus to Influence checks for 1 hour.

name: Ear Plugs
description: Muffles noise, good with firearms.
effect: Take a -4 penalty to Observation while worn.

name: Multipurpose Tool
description: Compact tool with multiple functions.
effect: Grants +1 bonus to Survival checks.

name: Magnifying Glass
description: Useful for close inspections and starting fires.
effect: As an action, gain a +2 bonus to Observation.

name: Sewing Kit
description: Contains needles, thread, and buttons.
effect: Gives Advantage on Crafting checks to repair clothing or other cloth based items.

name: Waterproof Tarp
description: Durable tarp for shelter and protection.

name: Lock Pick Set
description: Slim picks and tension wrenches in a leather roll.
effect: Grants advantage on Stealth checks to unlock locks. On a failure the lockpick is broken.

name: Ouija Board
description: A lacquered board of letters with a heart-shaped planchette.
effect: Make a Spirit check to either commune with spirits in the area, or trick another creature into thinking you are.

name: Crystal Ball
description: A flawless sphere of polished quartz.
effect: As an action once per day, make a Spirit check to either commune with spirits in the area, or glimpse a vague, distorted vision of a future event.

name: Opera Glasses
description: Gilded miniature binoculars on a handle.
effect: Grants +4 bonus to Observation while in a theatre.

name: Masquerade Mask
description: An ornate mask for balls and secretive gatherings.
effect: Grants +1 bonus to Influence.

name: Deck of Cards
description: For games.

name: Smoking Pipe
description: Tobacco device.

name: Eyeglasses
description: Wire-framed corrective lenses.
effect: Grants +4 bonus to Observation if you have a negative from a disability.

name: Hand Mirror
description: Portable mirror.

name: Umbrella
description: A sturdy canopy on a folding frame.
effect: While equipped, grants immunity to water and solar damage from the environment.

name: Lucky Cufflinks
description: Elegant cufflinks said to bring good fortune.
effect: Grants +1 bonus to Luck.

name: Power Suit and Tie
description: A sleek professional suit symbolizing authority.
effect: Grants +1 bonus to Influence.

name: Elegant Ball Gown
description: A stunning gown for formal events.
effect: Grants +1 bonus to Influence.

name: Charm Bracelet
description: A delicate bracelet with captivating charms.
effect: Grants +1 bonus to Influence.

name: Dapper Fedora
description: A stylish hat adding sophistication.
effect: Grants +1 bonus to Intellect.

name: Silk Scarf
description: Aids in blending into crowds.
effect: Grants +1 bonus to Stealth.

name: High-Performance Sneakers
description: Designed for comfort and speed.
effect: Grants +1 bonus to Agility.

name: Mystic's Cloak
description: Shimmers with otherworldly energy.
effect: Grants +1 bonus to Spirit.

name: Explorer's Vest
description: Pockets and compartments for adventurous souls.
effect: Grants +1 bonus to Survival.

name: Glittering Cocktail Dress
description: Dazzles and captivates in social settings.
effect: Grants +1 bonus to Influence.

name: Vintage Aviator Jacket
description: Rugged, stylish, reminiscent of daring pilots.
effect: Grants +1 bonus to Observation.

name: Embroidered Overalls
description: A beautifully crafted garment showcasing artistic skill.
effect: Grants +1 bonus to Crafting.

name: Sleek Spy Trench Coat
description: Perfect for concealing identities. Has a built-in hidden pocket.
effect: Grants +1 bonus to Stealth.

name: Flamboyant Cape
description: A sweeping cape of vivid silk.
effect: Flourish: once per day, make a grand entrance with advantage on Influence.

name: Red Bull Jacket
description: A vibrant red jacket that infuriates bovines.
effect: Grants +3 bonus to Influence with cloven creatures

name: Citrus Cloak
description: Infused with a strong citrus scent that cats dislike.
effect: Repels felines.

name: Shimmering Merfolk Robe
description: Adorned with scales that glimmer like a mermaid's tail.
effect: Grants +3 bonus to Influence with aquatic creatures.

name: Stormcaller's Mantle
description: Crackles with static energy.
effect: Attracts lightning in storms.

name: Vox-Pair
description: Matched earpiece and transceiver, molded to fit any ear.
effect: Press to transmit to any paired unit on the same frequency.

name: Crystal Relay
description: Backpack receiver paired with handheld crystal blocks.
effect: Intercepts a given band. The handheld blocks only work in range of the backpack.

name: Clarion Censor
description: A holy feather wrapped in celestial spider silk, sealed in a censer.
effect: Projects your voice to allies in the same realm only.

name: Hextell
description: A contracted demon spirit imbued into linked devices.
effect: Carries messages between linked devices. The spirit remembers everything it carries.

name: Sending Stones
description: A pair of stones bonded to each other.
effect: Speak to one and the other resonates with your voice nearby.

name: Wyrmvoice
description: An ethereal dragon spirit bound to a pair of speakers.
effect: Carries messages between speakers. Fast and far-reaching, but prone to embellishing what it delivers.

name: Runecaller
description: Linked runes small enough to fit on a coin.
effect: Transmits sound between the linked runes.

name: Storm Line
description: An open channel crackling with overlapping voices.
effect: Broadcasts to every user at once, and every user hears every other user. Some voices come through louder. Luck check to pick out the right message.

name: Mana Thread
description: A length of raw, unshaped mana spun into thread and anchored at each end.
effect: Speak near one anchor and it is heard at the other.

name: Echo Line
description: A line that runs forward through time rather than across distance.
effect: Sends a message across time rather than distance. One-way, delayed, no live conversation.

name: Skellephone
description: A small skeletal hand bound with a lingering spirit, wired into a shared hub.
effect: Speak into the palm and it is heard by every other Skellephone on the same hub.

name: Windcaller
description: A bound wind and sound elemental pair.
effect: Carries speech between two points. Weather can distort or drown the signal.

name: Bitter Root
description: A gnarled root chewed raw, sharp and unpleasant but clears the head fast.
effect: Remove 1 Mental condition

name: Stewed Vassgo Root
description: Meal; A thick root stew
effect: As a 1 hour action up to 3 times per day, heal 10 Wounds.

name: Hearthbread
description: Meal; A hearty home-baked loaf.
effect: As a 1 hour action up to 3 times per day, gain +1 to all Mental checks for 1 hour

name: Ironshell Porridge
description: Meal; A dense grain porridge that sits heavy
effect: As a 1 hour action up to 3 times per day, gain +1 to all Physical checks for 1 hour

name: Ashfeast
description: Banquet; A smoked, charred feast eaten before battle.
effect: As a 4 hour action once per day, gain the effects of a long rest.

name: Rain Boots
description: A pair of brightly colored rubber boots
effect: While worn, you take 2 less damage from fluid damage

name: Field Salve
description: A tin of gritty green paste that smells of crushed stems.
effect: As an action, remove the Bleeding condition from yourself or a creature within reach.

name: Bitterroot Draught
description: Cloudy brown liquid in a stoppered clay bottle. Tastes worse than it smells.
effect: Removes the Coughing condition.

name: Salve of Mending
description: A waxy balm that warms on contact with skin.
effect: When applied as an action, heals 1d6 wounds.

name: Waking Salts
description: A pinch of acrid crystals wrapped in waxed paper.
effect: As an action, wake an Unconscious creature within reach. It returns with 1 wound.

name: Clearsight Drops
description: A slim dropper of pale liquid that stings on application.
effect: Removes the Blind condition, and grants +2 to Observation for 1 minute.

name: Steadying Tonic
description: A heavy, syrupy drink that settles the nerves and the stomach.
effect: Removes the Fear and Confused conditions.

name: Ironhide Tonic
description: Flecks of suspended metal swirl when the vial is shaken.
effect: Gain 30 temporary Armor for 1 minute.

name: Mana Draught
description: Faintly luminous, and colder than the room it sits in.
effect: Restores 1d4 Mana.

name: Bonesetter's Salve
description: A dense grey clay that hardens over a limb as it works.
effect: Removes the Broken or Dislocation condition and heals 1d6 wounds.

name: Ghostwalk Philter
description: The liquid never quite touches the sides of its bottle.
effect: Gain the Intangible condition for 1 minute.

name: Elixir of Rebirth
description: Sealed in blown glass with a wax stamp no living guild still uses.
effect: When you would take the Death condition, drink as a reaction. Instead drop to 1 wound and remove the Injured condition.
